subject: general
question: The Narmada river rises in the ______ in Madhya Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**AmarKantak hills.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Anuppur, Madhya Pradesh**, India, there is a **Nagar Panchayat **and a **pilgrimage town** called** AmarKantak.**
 
• Amarkantak, also known as **"Teerthraj" **or **"the king of pilgrimages,"** is a **renowned Hindu pilgrimage site.**
 
• The **Maikal Hills **serve as the pivot at the intersection of the **Vindhya and Satpura Ranges.**
 
• This is where the** Narmada River, the Son River and Johila River **emerge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandu hills:**

 
 
• An **ancient city** known as **Mandu **can be seen in the **Dhar district's Mandav **area today.
 
• Because of the fort constructed by** Baaz Bahadur **in honor of his **queen Rani Roopmati,** it is well-known among tourists.
 
 
 
• **Pachmarhi hills:**
 
 
• In the** central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh, **in the **Narmadapuram district**, is the **hill station of Pachmarhi.**
 
• Due to its abundance of natural beauty, history, and culture, Pachmarhi is referred to as the** "queen of the Satpuras" **and is situated in the **Satpura mountain range.**
 
 
 
• **Omkareshwar hills:**
 
 
• In **Rajarajeshwari Nagar in South Bangalore**, there is a small hill called Omkareshwara Hill.
